key_idea: When the disc turns, the two holes always stay the same number of hours apart.
steps: In the first picture the holes show 12 and 3.
Going round the clock from 12 to 3 is 3 steps: 1, 2, 3.
Picture C shows 4 and 7. From 4 to 7 is also 3 steps: 5, 6, 7.

choice_feedback.B: From 2 to 4 is only 2 steps, not 3.
